parsed.answer: As of 2026-08-22, Ivo's Cobalt project uses STREAM-1-286 for delivery: Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286 on 2026-08-15, and the 2026-08-22 review kept that August 15 delivery choice. The retry policy is RETRY-1-907, which supersedes RETRY-1-108 as of the 2026-08-22 review. The August 8 REPLAY-1-632 item was a tested recovery procedure, not an approved delivery-mode change.

citations.quote: User Input: 2026-08-15. Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286. This supersedes the August 1 delivery decision.

2026-08-22. Ivo reviewed Cobalt. Keep the August 15 delivery choice. For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8. The retry policy is now RETRY-1-907, superseding RETRY-1-108.
The team tested REPLAY-1-632, which restored the missing updates. No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
